bio: CS grad (BSc + MSc) building practical web apps & tools. Languages, finance, and productivity — shipped with AI-assisted development

repodest.description: Repodest is a client-side GitHub repository analyzer and LLM-ready digest generator. Paste any GitHub URL, get a health score, language breakdown, file explorer, commit insights, and fun trophies — then pack selected files into a prompt you can paste straight into ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.

leitner-pro-max.description: 📚 Readner — Smart vocabulary learning with FSRS, PDF reader, spaced repetition, 13 languages. Single HTML file.

aidahl.description: OpenAI-compatible Telegram assistant with BYOK (users bring their own API keys), plus optional Manus Agent mode for image/edit/research tasks.

9router.description: Universal Multi-Provider AI Gateway & Telegram Mini App. Intelligently route, load-balance (Round-Robin, Smart Router, Fallback), and pool API keys across Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenAI with per-user encryption & vision support.

horde-survival-3d.description: 3D version of HordeSurvival - You can play it in your browsers

tgexplorer.description: A web app to explore public Telegram channels

speakai-coach.description: Real-time AI speaking coach for IELTS and everyday English practice

datalens.description: A local-first data workbench — paste or drop any data (CSV/JSON/YAML/XML/SQL/Excel), view it as a table, chart it, get stats and convert formats. 100% in-browser, zero dependencies, offline PWA.

codevis.description: Visual programming concepts explained through interactive canvas animations. A new concept every day — from data structures to design patterns — with step-by-step playback, synced code, and one-click PNG sharing. Zero dependencies, single HTML file, runs on GitHub Pages

mcp-studio.description: The Visual IDE & Testing Studio for Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers

bountyradar.description: Local Windows app that finds paid freelance & open-source bounties for any freelancer type — frontend, backend, mobile, data/ML, DevOps, security, docs/writing, design, full-stack.

ravaan.description: Ravaan (روان) — Windows typing assistant for bilingual Persian/English typists: layout conversion, smart ZWNJ, autocorrect, snippets, Jalali dates, and more.

devcompass.description: Free bilingual (FA/EN) quiz: which tech stack should you learn? 2-minute personality quiz with shareable result card, friend challenge links, and offline PWA. No backend.
